name: Hugh Martin
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Family problems from trivial to severe will challenge every family at some point. Family Therapy can feel like a real life saver, whether it’s adjusting to the teenage years, divorce, separation, managing conflict respectfully or grieving. Family members seek my help when they become stuck in repeating patterns of hurtful or harmful behaviour and have run out of ideas for solving problems.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues

name: Iuliia Kapinos
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Think of me as a friendly guide on a journey to understand your feelings. Life can sometimes be puzzling, and it's perfectly okay to seek help. As humans, we all have feelings, and it's important to take care of them.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Rae Sabine
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Hi, I'm Rae (they/them) and I live and work on unceded Wurundjeri Country, Kulin Nations. I'm a trans non-binary, multiple neurodivergent and chronically ill registered supervisor (I avoid using the term ‘clinical’ to describe the supervision work I do, as I prefer to use non-clinical language in my approaches), arts therapist, and psychotherapist with a lived experience of chronic illness. I am very passionate about disability rights, the LGBTQIA+ community and mental health. I am currently facilitating Creative Workshops at part of Switchboard’s LGBTQIA+ Suicide Bereavement Program. I have facilitated Arts Psychotherapy workshops for trans and non-binary folk and people with other marginalised genders outside of the Anglocentric gender binary through Your Community Health and young women, non-binary people, and trans people of any gender at Amplified Victoria (AKA Girls Rock) as well as for staff members at DFFH (Department of Families, Fairness and Housing).
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery
identity: trans non-binary, multiple neurodivergent and chronically ill

name: Irene Quintavalle
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Irene is an accredited Psychotherapist and Supervisor. She works with individuals and couples for a wide range of concerns: anxiety and depression, relational difficulties, attachment repair, low self-esteem concepts, lifestyle issues, somatic disturbances, chronic pain, trauma and PTSD, and on to existential matters and grief and loss. Trained in the Integrative Model of Psychotherapy and Trauma Model, Irene moves away from the traditional one-size-fits-all endeavour of therapy.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Joanne Gniel
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Jo Gniel (she/her) is a certified Emotionally Focused Therapist (EFT) and Supervisor in training and a trained teacher of Mindful Self-Compassion. She is the founder of landscape of life; dedicated to building human connection; helping people create healthy relationships and wellbeing in all aspects of life. As a relationship counsellor and psychotherapist, Jo integrates the paradigms and practices of modern psychology and neuroscience, Western relational psychology and Eastern contemplative practice to help individuals, couples and families develop a better understanding of themselves and others, navigate the challenges and transitions of life and make the changes they want in life.
specialties: Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery

name: Kate Horne
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: I am currently seeing clients in-person adjoining the beautiful forest of the Dandenong Ranges near Melbourne, and online. 'As you are, you are welcome' is the invisible sign above my therapy room door. I welcome clients of diverse ability, age, culture, ethnicity, faith, gender, gender identity, relationship structure and sexuality. “The purpose of a human being is to participate in the flourishing of life” – Charles Eisenstein
specialties: Sex and sexual issues, Somatic psychotherapy
